text: The Island Games in 2025 will continue until July 18.
The 2025 Island Games run until 18 July.
The opening ceremony of the 22nd staging of the games will be attended and officially opened by the Princess Royal, Princess Anne, and will be hosted by broadcaster Lorraine Kelly.
The 22nd staging of the games will see Saturday's opening ceremony attended and officially opened by the Princess Royal - Princess Anne - and hosted by broadcaster Lorraine Kelly.
2025 sees the Island Games hosted by Orkney.
